Rashi on Nazir 24a:10:1.hebrew: אמר רב חסדא ר' יהודה היא - דאמר: אדם מביא קרבן אשתו, וקמשמע לן דכי משתעבד כו'. דאי לרבנן, לא מבעיא למימר דכי הפר לה דתצא ותרעה בעדר, אלא אפי' כי לא הפר לה נמי תצא, דלדידהו לא משתעבד לה כלל:
Rashi on Nazir 24a:10:1.english: Rav Ḥisda said: It is Rabbi Yehuda - For he says [that] a man brings his wife’s offering; and [the Mishnah] teaches us that when he is obligated, etc. For if [it were according to] the Rabbis, it would not need to be said that when he nullified [her vow] that it goes out and grazes in the flock; rather, even when he did not nullify [her vow], it would also go out [and graze], since according to them he is not obligated to her at all.

Rashi on Nazir 24a:11:1.hebrew: ואלא היכי דמי דמשעבד - ובעי לאוקמא כרבנן: כגון דאקנייה ניהלה לנזירותה — אכתי לא מיתוקמא כרבנן, דכיון דאקנייה לה, הוה דנפשה וחטאת תמות, ואנן בעינן דתצא ותרעה בעדר. והלכך, לא מיתוקמא כלל כרבנן:
Rashi on Nazir 24a:11:1.english: And rather, what are the circumstances where he is obligated - And [the Gemara] seeks to establish [the Mishnah] in accordance with the Rabbis: [namely,] for example, where he transferred [the animal] to her for her naziriteship. [Yet] still, it cannot be established in accordance with the Rabbis, for since he transferred it to her, it became her own, and [consequently the] sin offering must die, whereas we require that it go out and graze in the herd. And therefore, it cannot be established at all in accordance with the Rabbis.

Rashi on Nazir 24a:1:1.hebrew: זכתה וקדמה ארבעה דורות בישראל - עובד, ישי, דוד, שלמה; ואילו צעירה לא אתת בישראל עד רחבעם, דהוה מנעמה העמונית:
Rashi on Nazir 24a:1:1.english: She merited and preceded [her by] four generations in Israel - Obed, Jesse, David, [and] Solomon; whereas [the descendant of] the younger [daughter] did not come into Israel until Rehoboam, who was [born] of Naamah the Ammonitess.

Rashi on Nazir 24a:3:1.hebrew: החטאת תמות - אותה הבהמה שהפרישה לשם חטאת תמות, וכי ההיא טעמא דפרשינן לעיל — דצריכה כפרה, והויא כחטאת שמתו בעליה, דגמירי דלמיתה אזלה:
Rashi on Nazir 24a:3:1.english: The sin-offering shall die - That animal that she set aside for the sake of a sin-offering shall die, and [this is] according to that reason that we explained earlier — that [a sin-offering] requires atonement, and [thus] it is like a sin-offering whose owner has died, as it is learned by tradition that it goes to die.

Rashi on Nazir 24a:4:1.hebrew: מעות סתומין - שלא פירש אלו לחטאת, ואלו לעולה, ואלו לשלמים — הרי אלו יפלו לנדבה, ולוקחים בהן עולות — הבשר למזבח, והעורות לכהנים:
Rashi on Nazir 24a:4:1.english: Unallocated funds - Where one did not specify, “These are for a sin-offering, and these are for a burnt-offering, and these are for peace-offerings” — these [funds] shall fall to [communal] gift-offerings, and they purchase with them burnt-offerings — the meat is for the altar and the hides are for the priests.

Rashi on Nazir 24a:5:1.hebrew: שלמים יביאו שלמים - ואצ"ל דאין מועלים בהן, וכדמפרש בפ"ק דמסכת מעילה (דף ו:):
Rashi on Nazir 24a:5:1.english: Peace-offerings, they shall bring peace-offerings - And it is needless to say that one is not liable for misuse with them, as is explained in the first chapter of Tractate Meilah (6b).

Rashi on Nazir 24a:6:1.hebrew: מאן תנא דלא משעבד לה - מאן הוא תנא דתני דקסבר שאם היתה הבהמה שלו לא חייל עליה קדושה כלל, דאמר תצא ותרעה בעדר, משום דבעל לא משעבד לה להביא קרבנותיה כלל; וכי מפרישה לה היא לנזירות — הרי הוא כמו שמקדיש דבר שאינו שלו, דאין בדבריו כלום:
Rashi on Nazir 24a:6:1.english: Who is the Tanna [who holds] that [a husband] is not obligated to her - Who is the Tanna who taught [this], maintaining that if the animal belonged to him, sanctity does not take effect upon it at all, as he said [that] it shall go out and graze in the herd, because a husband is not obligated to her to bring her offerings at all; and when she designates it for her nezirut, it is as [one] who consecrates an item that is not his, for his words are of no effect.

Rashi on Nazir 24a:6:2.hebrew: אמר רב חסדא רבנן היא דאי ס"ד ר' יהודה היא אמאי תצא - הא כיון דמשעבד בקרבנותיה, אישתכח דכי הקדישה — שפיר הקדישה; דהא שמעינן ליה בב"מ בפ' [המקבל] (דף קד.) שהיה דורש לשון הדיוט:
Rashi on Nazir 24a:6:2.english: Rav Ḥisda said: It is the Rabbis, for if it should enter your mind that it is Rabbi Yehuda, why should it go out - Behold, since he is obligated for her offerings, it turns out that when she consecrated [it], she consecrated [it] validly; for we have heard of him in Bava Metzia in the chapter [entitled] [HaMekabbel] (104a) that he would expound common phrasing [in contracts].

Rashi on Nazir 24a:7:1.hebrew: דתניא ר' יהודה אומר אדם מביא קרבן עשיר על אשתו - שאם היתה עניה ונתחייבה קרבן עני, ולא הספיקה להביא קרבן עני עד שניסת לו — ה"ז מביא קרבן עשיר על אשתו. וכן בכל קרבנות שהיא חייבת קודם לכן, ואפי' קרבן קבוע שאינו בעולה ויורד:
Rashi on Nazir 24a:7:1.english: As it is taught: Rabbi Yehuda says, a person brings the offering of a rich man on behalf of his wife - For if she was poor and became obligated in the offering of a poor person, and did not manage to bring the offering of a poor person until she was married to him — he brings the offering of a rich man on behalf of his wife. And likewise with all offerings that she was obligated [to bring] prior to that, even a fixed offering that is not on a sliding scale:

Rashi on Nazir 24a:8:1.hebrew: שכך כתב לה בכתובתה כו' - והלכך, דהואיל ומשתעבד לה — אמאי לא הוי בהמה שלו כבהמה שלה, ואם היתה חטאת תמות, ואם עולה תקרב עולה:
Rashi on Nazir 24a:8:1.english: For so he wrote to her in her marriage contract, etc. - And therefore, since he is obligated to her, why should his animal not be [treated] like her animal, [so that] if it was a sin-offering it should die, and if a burnt-offering it should be offered as a burnt-offering?

Rashi on Nazir 24a:9:1.hebrew: במילתא דלא צריכא לה - כגון הכא דהיפר לה בעלה, לא משתעבד לה, ומש"ה לא קדשה, ותצא ותרעה בעדר:
Rashi on Nazir 24a:9:1.english: In a matter that is not necessary for her - Such as here, where her husband nullified [the vow] for her, he is not obligated to her, and for this reason [the animal] did not become consecrated, and it shall go out and graze in the herd.

Tosafot on Nazir 24a:10:1.hebrew: איכא דאמרי מאן תנא רבי יהודה היא וכי משעבד לה בתנאי כתובה במילתא דצריכא לה כו' - דאי לרבנן, לא משעבד בתנאי כתובה. והיכי דמי שמשתעבד לה, שיכולה להקריב מבהמותיו אם לא הפר לה? כגון דאקני לה — שנתן לה במתנה מבהמותיו. וכיון דאקני לה, הויא לה דנפשה, והוה לן למימר דחטאת תמות כמו [בשלה]? כי אקני לה — במילתא דצריכא לה, כגון אם לא הפר לה; במילתא דלא צריכא לה, כגון שהפר לה — לא אקני לה. ופי' הר"ם, דלא מיירי שנתן לה עתה לקרבנות נזירות, דא"כ קיים לה נדרה ושוב לא יוכל להפר; אלא כגון דאמר לה קודם לכן ימים רבים: "אם תצטרכי לקרבנות, תקחי מבהמותי":
Tosafot on Nazir 24a:10:1.english: Some say: Who is the tanna? It is Rabbi Yehuda, and when is he obligated to her via the terms of the marriage contract? In a matter that is necessary for her, etc. - For if [it were] according to the Rabbis, he is not obligated [to provide her offerings] via the terms of the marriage contract. And what are the circumstances where he is obligated to her, such that she can sacrifice from his animals if he did not annul [her vow]? For example, where he transferred [ownership] to her — that he gave her a gift from his animals. And since he transferred [ownership] to her, it became her own, and [so] should we not have said that the sin-offering must be left to die, just as [when it was separated] from her own [property]? [Rather,] when he transferred [ownership] to her, [he did so only] for a matter that she needs, such as if he did not annul [her vow]; [but] for a matter that she does not need, such as where he annulled [her vow], he did not transfer [ownership] to her. And Rabbeinu Meir explained that it is not dealing with [a case where] he gave [them] to her now for [her] nazirite offerings, for if so, he would have confirmed her vow for her and could no longer annul [it]; rather, for example, where he said to her many days prior: "If you [ever] need offerings, you may take from my animals."

Tosafot on Nazir 24a:1:1.hebrew: ארבעה דורות בישראל - עובד, ישי, דוד, שלמה. ואילו צעירה — לא הות בישראל עד רחבעם בן שלמה, שבא מנעמה העמונית:
Tosafot on Nazir 24a:1:1.english: "Four generations in Israel" - Obed, Jesse, David, [and] Solomon. Whereas the younger [daughter] was not in Israel until Rehoboam son of Solomon, who came from Naamah the Ammonite.

Tosafot on Nazir 24a:2:1.hebrew: האשה שנדרה בנזיר והפרישה בהמתה - שלשה בהמות: כבשה לחטאת, וכבש לעולה, ואיל לשלמים, שהן קרבן נזיר טהור. "ואח"כ הפר לה בעלה, אם משלו היתה הבהמה תצא ותרעה בעדר" — דכיון דהיפר לה בעלה, אין כאן נזירות כלל, והבהמה שהפריש דין חולין עליה; כדאמר בגמרא: "כי אקני לה מידי דצריכא לה, מידי דלא צריכא לה לא אקני לה", ונמצא שלא היתה קודש כלל:
Tosafot on Nazir 24a:2:1.english: "A woman who vowed to be a nazirite and separated her animal" - [This means] three animals: a female lamb for a sin-offering, a male lamb for a burnt-offering, and a ram for a peace-offering, which are the offering of a ritually pure nazirite. "And afterward her husband nullified [her vow], if the animal was his, it shall go out and graze among the flock" — for since her husband nullified [the vow] for her, there is no naziriteship here at all, and the animal that was separated has the status of non-sacred property, as [the Gemara] says in the Gemara: "When he transfers [ownership] to her, [it is only for] a matter that she needs; for a matter that she does not need, he does not transfer [ownership] to her," and thus it turns out that it was not sacred at all.

Tosafot on Nazir 24a:3:1.hebrew: ואם משלה הבהמה - ובגמרא מפרש: מאין תבא לה, שלא יהא לבעלה רשות בו:
Tosafot on Nazir 24a:3:1.english: "And if the animal was hers" - And in the Gemara, it explains from where [such an animal] could come to her, such that her husband would have no rights to it.

Tosafot on Nazir 24a:3:2.hebrew: החטאת [תמות] - אע"ג דהפר לה, כדמפרש לה טעמא דמתניתין: כיון דבעיא כפרה, הויא כחטאת שמתו בעליה:
Tosafot on Nazir 24a:3:2.english: "The sin-offering [must die]" - Even though he nullified [the vow] for her, [it must die,] as [the Gemara] explains the reason of the Mishnah: Since she required atonement, it is like a sin-offering whose owner died.

Tosafot on Nazir 24a:3:3.hebrew: והעולה תקרב עולה - וא"ת: ולר' ישמעאל, דאמר לעיל (נזיר דף יט:) דעולה לאו דורון הוא ולא קריבה כי הפר לה בעלה — אטו פליג נמי אמתני' דהכא, דתני בהדיא דעולה קריבה עולה אע"ג דהיפר לה בעלה? וי"ל, דאפי' רבי ישמעאל מודה בנזיר טהור דעולת בהמה דורון הוא; דדוקא גבי נזיר טמא, דכתיב ביה "וכפר" וכתיב "עולה" בההיא קרא — משמע ליה דעולה נמי באה לכפרה:
Tosafot on Nazir 24a:3:3.english: "And the burnt-offering is sacrificed as a burnt-offering" - And if you say: According to Rabbi Yishmael, who said above (Nazir 19b) that a burnt-offering is not a gift and is not sacrificed when her husband nullified [her vow] for her, does he then also disagree with the Mishnah here, which explicitly teaches that the burnt-offering is sacrificed as a burnt-offering even though her husband nullified [her vow] for her? And one can say that even Rabbi Yishmael concedes in [the case of] a pure nazirite that an animal burnt-offering is a gift; for specifically regarding an impure nazirite, concerning whom it is written: "And make atonement," and "burnt-offering" is written in that [same] verse, it implies to him that the burnt-offering also comes for atonement.

Tosafot on Nazir 24a:3:4.hebrew: שלמים (נמי) יקרבו שלמים ונאכלין ליום אחד - כחומר שלמי נזיר. ואפי' למ"ד בעל מיעקר עקר, [כיון] שהיא קדשם לדין שלמי נזיר, יאכלו בכל החומר שבהן. והא דקאמר בגמרא: "שלמי נזיר ששחטן שלא כמצותן (היינו) אין להם זרוע", ומדמה ליה להכי — היינו אין להם זרוע כמצותו שיטעון בתנופה, אבל מ"מ הזרוע מיתסר כחומר שלמי נזיר. ועוד אומר ר"ת, דאין להם זרוע היינו דאין להם דין זרוע בשילה שיתבשל עם האיל, אלא לבדו אסריניה:
Tosafot on Nazir 24a:3:4.english: "Peace-offerings (also) shall be offered as peace-offerings, and they are eaten for one day" - [This is] in accordance with the stringency of a nazirite's peace-offering. And even according to the one who says [that when] a husband [nullifies his wife's vow, he] uproots [it retroactively], [since] she consecrated them according to the law of a nazirite's peace-offering, they must be eaten with all the stringency that applies to them. And that which [the Gemara] says in the Gemara: "A nazirite's peace-offerings that were slaughtered not in accordance with their mitzvah (that is) have no foreleg," and compares it to this — that means they have no foreleg according to its mitzvah, that it should require waving; but nevertheless, the foreleg is forbidden [to non-priests], in accordance with the stringency of a nazirite's peace-offering. And furthermore, Rabbeinu Tam says that "they have no foreleg" means that they do not have the rule of a "boiled foreleg" [requiring] that it be cooked with the ram; rather, we forbid it on its own.

Tosafot on Nazir 24a:3:5.hebrew: ה"ג ואינם טעונין לחם - כשאר, דכתיב: "על כפי הנזיר", ואין כאן "כפי הנזיר", דהפר לה. ואם הקדישו כבר — טעון פדייה; ואפילו אי מיעקר עקר — גזירה שמא יאמרו: "הקדש יוצא בלא פדייה"; ואי מיגז גייז — נמי מצי לפדות, דאין לו קדושת הגוף עד שישחט עליו הקרבן:
Tosafot on Nazir 24a:3:5.english: This is the reading: "And they do not require bread" - Like other [peace-offerings], as it is written: "Upon the hands of the nazirite" (Numbers 6:19), and there are no "hands of the nazirite" here, since he nullified [her vow] for her. And if she had already consecrated it, it requires redemption; and even if [the husband's nullification] uproots [the vow retroactively, this is a rabbinic] decree lest people say: "Consecrated property goes out without redemption"; and if [it merely] severs [the vow from this point forward], one can also redeem it, because it does not possess inherent sanctity until the sacrifice is slaughtered for it.

Tosafot on Nazir 24a:4:1.hebrew: ה"ג: היו לה מעות סתומים יפלו לנדבה - היכא דהפר לה — בגמרא מפרש דהנהו סתומים יפלו לנדבה: לחולין ולמזבח, דהיינו עולת נדבה, ונסכיה באין משל ציבור; וכן פי' בכל דוכתי דתנינא "יפלו לנדבה". ולא חש למיתני הכא: "אם שלו הן — חולין", כדתני ברישא:
Tosafot on Nazir 24a:4:1.english: This is the reading: "If she had unallocated funds, they shall fall to a freewill offering" - [This refers to a case] where he nullified [her vow] for her. In the Gemara, it explains that those unallocated [funds] "shall fall to a freewill offering" — [divided between] non-sacred [property, if the money was his,] and the altar [if it was hers], that is, a voluntary burnt-offering whose libations come from communal funds; and so [it is] explained in all places where we learn "they shall fall to a freewill offering." And [the Tanna] was not concerned to teach here: "If they were his, [they are] non-sacred," as he taught in the first clause.

Tosafot on Nazir 24a:4:2.hebrew: מפורשים - שפירש: "אלו דמים לחטאת, ואלו לעולה, ואלו לשלמים":
Tosafot on Nazir 24a:4:2.english: Allocated [funds] - That one specified: "These funds are for a sin-offering, and these are for a burnt-offering, and these are for a peace-offering."

Tosafot on Nazir 24a:4:3.hebrew: דמי חטאת ילכו לים המלח - כיון דאילו היתה הבהמה, הוה אזלה למיתה. ולא [נהנין] מאותן מעות — מדרבנן; ולא מועלין — דכיון דלים המלח אזלו, לא קרינן ביה "קדשי [ה']". וה"ה דלעיל גבי בהמה, מצי למיתני: "לא נהנין ולא מועלין":
Tosafot on Nazir 24a:4:3.english: "The money for the sin-offering goes to the Dead Sea" - Since if it had been the animal, it would have gone to die. And [the rule that] one may not [derive benefit] from that money is rabbinic; and [the rule that] one does not commit me'ilah is because once they go to the Dead Sea, we do not read regarding it "the sacred things of [the Lord]." And the same applies above regarding the animal: [the Mishnah] could have taught "one may not derive benefit and does not commit me'ilah."

Tosafot on Nazir 24a:5:1.hebrew: דמי עולה יביאו עולה - דדורון הוא. ומועלין בהם — כיון דקריבין למזבח:
Tosafot on Nazir 24a:5:1.english: "The money for a burnt-offering shall be used to bring a burnt-offering" - For it is a gift [offering]. And [the law of] misuse applies to them, since they are offered on the altar.

Tosafot on Nazir 24a:5:2.english: "The money for a peace-offering, a peace-offering is brought, and it is eaten for one day and does not require bread" - As I explained [earlier].

Tosafot on Nazir 24a:6:1.hebrew: מאן תנא דלא משתעבד לה - ולכך יש סברא לחלק בין בהמה דידיה, דתני: "תצא ותרעה בעדר", ואם [שלה] — "חטאת תמות"; דאי משתעבד לה, לא היה סברא לחלק בין בהמתו לבהמתה:
Tosafot on Nazir 24a:6:1.english: "Who is the tanna [who holds] that [the husband] is not indebted to her" - And therefore there is reason to distinguish between his animal, where [the Mishnah] teaches: "It shall go out and graze among the flock," and if [it was] hers: "The sin-offering must die"; for if he were indebted to her, there would be no reason to distinguish between his animal and her animal.

Tosafot on Nazir 24a:6:2.hebrew: אמר רב חסדא רבנן היא - וכדמפרש ואזיל. ומ"מ, אם לא הפר לה היתה מקריבתה לחובתה, כיון דאקני לה, וכדמפרש בסמוך (הפר לה — לא אמר דהא הוו בהמות דידה, כדמפרש בסמוך); כי מקני לה — מידי דצריכא לה, במידי דלא צריכא לה, כגון דהיפר לה — לא אקני לה:
Tosafot on Nazir 24a:6:2.english: Rav Ḥisda said: It is the Rabbis - And as [the Gemara] goes on to explain. And nevertheless, if he had not nullified [her vow], she would have sacrificed it for her obligation, since he transferred ownership [of the animal] to her, as [the Gemara] explains nearby ([and as for why in the case where] he nullified [her vow, the tanna] did not say: "Behold, they are her animals," as [the Gemara] explains nearby); for when he transfers ownership to her, [it is only for] something that she needs; in [the case of] something that she does not need, such as where he nullified [the vow] for her, he did not transfer ownership to her.

Tosafot on Nazir 24a:6:3.hebrew: דאי ס"ד רבי יהודה היא אמאי תצא ותרעה בעדר הא [משועבד לה בתנאי כתובה] - כדמפרש ואזיל. וס"ד דתנאי כתובה עדיף, ואפי' במידי דלא צריכא לה נמי משועבד לה:
Tosafot on Nazir 24a:6:3.english: "For if it should enter your mind that it is Rabbi Yehuda, why should it go out and graze in the flock? Isn't [he obligated to her through a stipulation of the marriage contract]?" - As [the Gemara] goes on to explain. And [the Gemara] assumed that a stipulation of the marriage contract is stronger, and even for something that she does not need, he is also obligated to her.

Tosafot on Nazir 24a:6:4.hebrew: דתניא ר' יהודה אומר מביא אדם קרבן עשיר על אשתו - פי': אם עשיר הוא [והיא חייבת קרבן עולה ויורד], צריך להביא קרבן עשיר עליה, ולא יוכל לומר: "והלא אין לה כלום, ותביא קרבן עני". וכן "כל קרבנותיה שהיא חייבת" — להביא קרבן בעבורה; ודווקא חובות שהיא חייבת, כגון יולדת וזבה, אבל נדרים ונדבות — לאו כל כמינה לידור אלף עולה ליום. ואומר ר"י, דדוקא אותן שנתחייבה משנשאת ואילך, ולא שנתחייבה קודם שנשאת:
Tosafot on Nazir 24a:6:4.english: "As it is taught: Rabbi Yehuda says: A person brings the offering of a rich man on behalf of his wife" - Explanation: If he is wealthy [and she is liable for a sliding-scale offering], he must bring the offering of a rich person on her behalf, and he cannot say: "Behold, she has nothing [of her own], so let her bring the offering of a poor person." And similarly, [the clause] "all her offerings that she is obligated [to bring]" [means that he is required] to bring an offering on her behalf; and [this applies] specifically to obligatory offerings that she is bound to bring, such as [those of] a woman after childbirth and a zavah, but [as for] vows and freewill offerings — it is not within her power to vow a thousand burnt-offerings a day [at his expense]. And the Ri says that [this applies] specifically to those [offerings] for which she became obligated from [the time] she was married and onward, and not to those for which she became obligated before she was married.

Tosafot on Nazir 24a:7:1.hebrew: הכי גריס רש"י שכך כותבת [ליה] כל אחריות דאית לי עלך מקדמת דנא - והכי איתא [בתורת כהנים פרשת מצורע]. ופירוש: דאשה שגרשה בעלה, לאחר ששילם לה בעלה כתובתה, כותבת לו שובר: "התקבלתי כתובתי, וכל אחריות דאית לי עלך מן קדמת דנא הכל מחלתי"; אלמא [דמשום] דמשועבד לה, צריכה לפוטרו בשעת גירושין:
Tosafot on Nazir 24a:7:1.english: This is Rashi's reading: "For so she writes [to him]: All claims of guarantee that I have against you from beforehand" - And so it is stated [in Torat Kohanim, Parashat Metzora]. And the explanation is that a woman whose husband divorced her, after her husband paid her her ketubah, writes him a receipt: "I have received my ketubah, and all claims of guarantee that I have against you from beforehand, I have waived everything." It is evident that [because] he is obligated to her, she must release him at the time of divorce.

Tosafot on Nazir 24a:9:1.hebrew: אפי' תימא ר' יהודה כי משעבד לה במילתא דצריכא [לה במידי דלא צריכא] - כגון דהפר לה, לא משעבד לה כלל, ואע"ג דמשועבד לה בתנאי בית דין. הלכך בהמה שלו תצא ותרעה בעדר, דהוו חולין גמורין ולא הוו כבהמתה:
Tosafot on Nazir 24a:9:1.english: "You can even say [it is] Rabbi Yehuda: When he is obligated to her, [it is] in a matter that is necessary [for her; in a matter that is not necessary]" - [In a case] such as where he annulled [the vow] for her, he is not obligated to her at all, even though he is [otherwise] obligated to her by court enactment. Therefore, his animal goes out and grazes in the herd, for it is completely non-sacred property, and is not like her animal.
